title: Philippines Remittance Inclusion Operations
thesis: Snowflake turns daily activity from 40 synthetic remittance pickup sites in the inclusion programme of a fictional Philippine rural bank into account-opening and onboarding-blocker KPIs, 7-day abandoned-application risk scores, eKYC error-rate anomalies and grounded AI answers, all on curated dynamic tables.

talking_points: Blocker-free pickup rate, savings accounts opened, pickup-to-account conversion and abandoned-application blockers for 40 sites in Batangas City, Tacloban City, General Santos City, Angeles City and Naga City.
Every KPI is a numerator over a denominator in a curated dynamic table, so it can be traced back to site-day rows.
The blocker-type chart shows which onboarding blockers end in abandoned applications and which always resolve, such as area power interruptions.
tabs.call_out: One governed set of inclusion KPIs, traceable to source rows

transition.line: Which sites should the onboarding desk watch first?

talking_points: Snowflake ML classification scores each site's probability of an onboarding blocker that ends in an abandoned application in the next 7 days.
The holdout line shows precision and recall on the most recent 14 labelled days, against the base rate.
Anomaly detection flags eKYC error rate outliers per site, and the forecast projects programme-wide blocker volume for 14 days.
tabs.call_out: Honest, evaluated ML inside the data platform

transition.line: Are dormant-account follow-ups and partner documents keeping up?

talking_points: Dormant-account follow-up completion, partner document coverage and pending documents frame the site control gaps.
Follow-up completion against abandoned applications by site shows where missed follow-ups and dropouts move together; it is an association, not proof of cause.
The action memo drafts three prioritised actions from the KPI, site, blocker-type and risk tables only.
show: Follow-up completion and partner document coverage
tabs.call_out: Grounded draft actions, with a human in the loop

transition.line: What happens when a site logs a blocker right now?

talking_points: Live remittance pickup events land in RAW.LIVE_PICKUPS, from the simulator or from Amazon Data Firehose through Snowpipe.
The Snowflake alert logs BLOCKER events with an SOP hint and the site's current risk band, then emails the on-call analyst.
tabs.call_out: From onboarding blocker to ticket in one platform

talking_points: The Cortex Agent uses Cortex Analyst over the semantic view for metrics, and Cortex Search over 14 synthetic onboarding-blocker SOPs.
Each answer shows the generated SQL and the SOPs it cited.

transition.line: Here is how it is built.

talking_points: Two builds share one core: Snowflake only, or AWS + Snowflake (Data Firehose, Bedrock, QuickSight and Amazon Q).
Everything shown is synthetic demo data, rebuilt reproducibly from the repo.
tabs.call_out: One governed core, with an optional AWS edge
